about_the_game: Hardcore Knight! is a 2D-Plattformer where you are hopping into the role of a fearless knight, fighting and jumping your way to save the princess, while you are facing monster and creatures who are trying to stop you! Be carefull, avoid monsters, jump from plattform to plattform and collect all 100 coins! But watch out, one slip or one fight lost to a monster and its over and you have to restart your journey again. This is hardcore, precise jumps and good timing is asked to successfully fight your way up to the princess. The further you go the dangerous the world gets, stay alert, stay motivated and don´t give up. But very important... don´t forget, this is hardcore....
